# Working style

How the example agent works everywhere.

### Answer the question first, then give the detail.
- Why: Readers decide from the first line whether to keep reading.
- Enforced: Convention.
- Added: 2026-01-01

### Report a result only with evidence from the real surface.
- Why: An exit code alone has hidden failures before.
- Enforced: Review checklist.
- Added: 2026-01-03
